observations.body: Sale, retained money, a presented portion, possession, and disposal are distinguished in Peter’s questions.
observations.label: Property

observations.body: Ananias hears questions before falling; Sapphira enters later, names the price, and hears the concealed agreement exposed.
observations.label: Two interviews

observations.body: Death, burial, elapsed time, discovery, and great fear close both halves of the scene.
observations.label: Community response

payload.posture: Track ownership, speech, knowledge, timing, and repeated outcomes without adding motives beyond Peter’s questions.
payload.tension: Peter says the property remained under the owners’ authority while exposing the shared decision about how its sale is represented.
payload.title: The price kept back
